lines.zh: 雪原上的骨头，冻得很脆。
lines.en: Snowfield bones freeze brittle.

lines.zh: 前面有炊烟，可能是活人。
lines.en: Smoke ahead; likely the living.
I cast no shadow, only frost.

lines.zh: 风把活人的味道送来了。
lines.en: The wind brings the smell of the living.
Wind whistles through my ribs.
This ice road leads to my grave.
woods... I can't go back.
Snow is packed into my joints.
The snow glare stings even my bones.

lines.zh: 雪盖住了我来时的脚印。
lines.en: Snow covered the tracks I came by.

lines.zh: 雪地上，我的骨头比雪还白。
lines.en: On snow, my bones are whiter than snow.
My knee bones creak.

lines.zh: 生前我在这块石头上歇脚。
lines.en: In life I rested on this stone.
My back is bent now; it hardly matters.

lines.zh: 我好像忘了把弓藏哪了。
lines.en: I seem to have forgotten where I left my bow.
Frost in my eye sockets; I can't blink.
Still holding my bones.

lines.zh: 冰刺之间，我的骨节冻在一起。
lines.en: Between ice spikes my joints freeze together.
I have stood long beneath the ice.
Wind whistles through my bones.
Snow settles between my ribs and stays.
Snowfield bones are whiter than snow.
My finger bones show white in the snow.
They call me Frigid Skeleton. Remember.
Your shadow has warmth; rare.
In the cold, bones turn brittle.
On this snowfield only I stand.

lines.zh: 你的脸冻红了，像我从前。
lines.en: Your face is red with cold, as mine once was.
A living one, still warm.
Snow glare spoils my aim.
The white breath you exhale is warm.
Stand still and save me some steps.
Arm gone, and I still walk.

lines.zh: 手指冻裂了，箭也拉不开。
lines.en: My fingers cracked with frost — I can't draw.
My bowstring froze — it won't draw.
Break one bone; I have others.
Do not touch that; it is a break.
One rib cracked.
I remember your weapon.
No pain, only cold.
One more hit and I fall apart.
My shoulder blade is out of place.
That smell stirs old memories.

lines.zh: 雪把我的箭头冻得发白。
lines.en: The snow has frosted my arrowheads white.
This bone still carries the cold.
Frozen meat is too hard for my teeth.
Even my jaw is frosted over.

lines.zh: 那点金光，我生前也追过。
lines.en: I chased that glint of gold in life too.
My footprints do not melt in the snow.
I can smell frozen meat.
Toss one piece over, just one.
My fingers are frozen, I cannot draw.
My shoulder fell off; pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 你的热气让我的霜化了。
lines.en: Your warmth melts the frost on me.
The living carry a furnace inside.
Slow down; my bones do not take hits.
Do not step there; that is my finger.
Sorry, my elbow bone is sharp.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀磕在我的锁骨上。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my collarbone.
You knocked loose one finger bone.
Ice grit is stuck between my ribs.

lines.zh: 走开，冰渣都嵌进我骨头了。
lines.en: Back off, ice shards are in my bones.
Then we stand side by side and watch the snow.

lines.zh: 我的胸腔里，什么也没跳。
lines.en: Nothing beats inside my chest.
On snowfields my bones freeze white.
I have time; you do not.
Walk beside me; do not hold my hand.

lines.zh: 我的手臂会从肩头脱落。
lines.en: My arm would slip from its socket.
You are too warm; I would melt.

lines.zh: 我的手指一碰就掉，别牵。
lines.en: My fingers fall off at a touch — do not hold them.

lines.zh: 我的手只剩骨头，抱不住。
lines.en: My hands are bone; they cannot hold.

lines.zh: 我的箭冻在弦上，下次再射。
lines.en: My arrow froze to the string; next time.
Frozen bone still makes an arrow.
This ice crystal shines like an eye.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨漏风，装不住东西。
lines.en: My ribs let the wind through; nothing stays.
Leave it on the ground; I bend badly.
A bone? No. A stick.
I pinch it between two finger bones.
This glove carries living sweat.

lines.zh: 雪原上的骨头，冻得发白。
lines.en: Bones on the snowfield freeze pale.

lines.zh: 指骨夹不住太滑的东西。
lines.en: Finger bones cannot grip smooth things.

lines.zh: 这截冻骨先收着，也许有用。
lines.en: I will keep this frozen bone; it may help.
Frostfield scent, very fresh.

lines.zh: 雪地里的骨头，冻得发白。
lines.en: Bones in the snow, frozen white.

lines.zh: 雪地上，别动，你踩脏了骨头。
lines.en: Stay put on the snow, you are dirtying my bones.
You need not run; I need not breathe.
That wisp of warmth in the snow is you.
I am in no hurry; my legs never tire.

lines.zh: 骨头认得出活人的方向。
lines.en: Bone knows which way the living go.
No living thing belongs on this snowfield.
On snow, turning around is too slow.
Tonight there will be warmth in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪原太静，你的心跳传得远。
lines.en: The snowplain is still; your heartbeat carries.
Once I see you, I do not lose you.
Arrow's nocked — don't rush.
You stepped into my snow pit.
My bones have frozen blue.
On ice, footprints do not lie.
There is only ice in my joints.
The more you run, the deeper the snow.

lines.zh: 雪地上，我的脚步没有声。
lines.en: On the snow, my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 从雪线那头，一直追到这。
lines.en: From beyond the snowline, all the way here.
I have crossed this ice for centuries.
With a broken leg bone, I still crawl.
If you fall, I need not chase.

lines.zh: 雪上脚步声太响，我听得见。
lines.en: Footsteps on snow are loud. I hear them.

lines.zh: 我的手快够到你的衣领。
lines.en: My hand is nearly at your collar.

lines.zh: 站住，让我数数你的肋骨。
lines.en: Stop, let me count your ribs.
Do not turn; my face is not pretty.
Your steps crack the ice too loudly.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我走得没有声音。
lines.en: In the snow, I walk without a sound.
In firelight, my shadow fades more.
The warmth you left has not faded.
Your panting is easy to follow.
Behind the snowbank, the path ends.
This blow comes from my elbow bone.
My bow hand is stiff with cold.

lines.zh: 这双手，只剩打人的用处。
lines.en: These hands are good only for hitting.
The ice is slick — my claws slipped.

lines.zh: 我的指节扣住了你的袖。
lines.en: My knuckles catch your sleeve.
The string is frozen; I pull it anyway.
Your bones are more brittle than mine.
Do not crush my ribs.

lines.zh: 这一箭在雪里冻了很久。
lines.en: This arrow froze a long time in the snow.
My finger bones rap your helmet.

lines.zh: 雪地上退一步，就陷一寸。
lines.en: One step back in snow sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 我的关节冻住了，动得慢。
lines.en: My joints froze — I move slowly.
My joints are brittle with cold.

lines.zh: 冰原上让开，别挡我的箭。
lines.en: Clear the ice — don't block my arrow.
Kneel; the snow will catch you.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的骨头上不化。
lines.en: Snow won't melt on my bones.
The frost on my bones thickens.
First I find which way the living went.
Living one — don't come near.
Frozen earth underfoot; familiar.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的弓弦上，结冰了。
lines.en: Snow froze on my bowstring.
I know this snowfield.
Firelight gives away my position.
woods... back again.
The snow glare aches in my sockets.

lines.zh: 我的箭袋冻成了一整块。
lines.en: My quiver froze into one block.
I push myself up from the frozen earth.
Out of the snowbank. Again.
Frozen soil loosened. I dug out.
Snow falls into my eye socket, cold.
Flames lick my ribs.

lines.zh: 从冰坡滚下来，断了两根。
lines.en: I rolled down the ice slope and broke two.
Icy water fills my chest.

lines.zh: 骨头散了一地，又拼回来。
lines.en: My bones scatter and pull back together.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder bone.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进骨缝，冷得发烫。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my bones, cold and burning.
One more day without food and my bones fall apart.

lines.zh: 雷一过，我的骨节都松了。
lines.en: After lightning my joints all loosen.
Not even soil here.
